names: National Day of Spain (Día de la Hispanidad)

events.text: Christopher Columbus's expedition reaches the Americas.
The first Oktoberfest is held in Munich to celebrate a royal wedding.
An iron lung is used for the first time, at Boston Children's Hospital.
Equatorial Guinea gains independence from Spain.
Douglas Adams's The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy is published as a novel.
The destroyer USS Cole is attacked by suicide bombers in Aden, Yemen.
Bombings in Bali, Indonesia, kill 202 people.
